seo.title: Who We Serve — SihaSpan
seo.description: Healthcare providers, insurers, government agencies, NGOs, foundations and health-technology companies — advisory sized to every mandate across the health ecosystem.

head.heading: Every part of the health ecosystem.
head.lede: Different mandates, one shared need: services that actually work for the people who depend on them.

items.body: Hospitals, clinics and networks planning growth or resolving operational strain.

items.title: Government agencies
items.body: Ministries and regulators developing policy, standards and oversight capacity.

items.title: NGOs
items.body: Implementing partners delivering programmes on the ground.

items.title: Foundations

items.title: Health-tech companies
